description:
`evidence.artifact.read` input.

The `artifact_id` is the `ArtifactRef::id` of one of the artifacts bound to the named `evidence_id`. The runtime refuses to serve bytes for an `artifact_id` the named evidence row does not reference, so the tool exposes the bytes of *that evidence row's* artifacts, not an arbitrary digest.
title: ReadArtifactInput

Digest.description:
Content digest: `{ algorithm, hex_value }`.

`value` must be the lowercase (or uppercase) hexadecimal string of length matching `algorithm.hex_length()`. Both cases are accepted at construction; the canonical lowercase form is stored.

oneOf.description: Git SHA-1. Preserved when a digest points at a Git object address from a legacy SHA-1 repository.
Git SHA-256. Preserved when a digest points at a Git object address from a SHA-256 repository.

description:
`evidence.artifact.read` output: the bytes of one artifact plus the `media_type` the artifact was stored with.

`bytes_base64` is the artifact payload encoded as standard base64 (RFC 4648, no URL-safe alphabet, no line wrapping). Clients decoding into a structured report (the only kind the runtime currently stores) should treat the result as a UTF-8 JSON document.

digest.description: The artifact's content-addressed identity, round-tripped so a client can confirm the on-the-wire bytes are the bytes the runtime stored.

media_type.description: The `media_type` declared on the `ArtifactRef` at write time (PHASE-0B.md §15). `None` if the producer did not declare one — the tool passes the absence through rather than guessing.

title: ReadArtifactOutput
